blocking_findings.issue: R-1 acknowledges Opus 1M user regression risk if currentModelCode is missing, but does NOT identify which Claude paths populate currentModelCode. Codex-verified grep: ONLY packages/happy-cli/src/agent/acp/sessionConfigMetadata.ts:97-113 writes metadata.currentModelCode. The normal Claude SDK path (runClaude.ts) does NOT. Therefore for the COMMON Claude path, M3's currentModelCode-aware branch will never fire, and real-1M Claude users on normal SDK will see 200K (regression). Spec's R-1 mitigation 'M3 metadata-aware consumer uses currentModelCode when present' is conditionally true but the spec hides that the condition is rarely satisfied in practice.
blocking_findings.recommendation: BA iter-3: explicitly enumerate WHICH Claude paths populate metadata.currentModelCode (ACP path: yes; normal SDK runClaude.ts path: no) and update R-1 to state: 'For real-1M Claude users on normal SDK path, M3 fallback is ineffective and they will see 200K denominator (regression from buggy 1M). User's iter-2 Q2 answer (no UX hint) makes this an accepted tradeoff. To eliminate this regression entirely, a future cycle would need to either (a) populate currentModelCode in runClaude.ts metadata, or (b) revert default Claude denominator to 1M. This cycle does neither.' The user's strict-scope decision should be reaffirmed against this honest scope picture.

minor_findings.issue: Regex case-sensitivity inconsistency: /1m$/i and proposed /\[1m\]/i are case-insensitive; modelKey.includes('-1m-') and modelKey.includes(':1m') are case-sensitive. A model code 'claude-OPUS-1M-2026' or 'claude:1M' would not match the includes branches but would match the regex branch. Pre-existing inconsistency, not introduced by Cycle 10, but spec could resolve by normalizing modelKey.toLowerCase() before all checks.
minor_findings.recommendation: Optional iter-3 polish: add 'normalize modelKey via .toLowerCase() prior to regex/includes checks' as M2 sub-clause, OR add a negative-case test fixture to M4 covering uppercase variants to lock current behavior.

minor_findings.issue: M6 requires ~100K token session for live verification. Dev daemon may not have such a session; QA may be blocked or forced to synthesize context buildup. The phrase '1M only when explicit [1m] marker' is technically inaccurate at the platform level; it is accurate at the app's conservative-fallback level.
